articles.title: The Redistricting Arms Race: How a Supreme Court Ruling Unleashed a National Map War
articles.summary: After the Supreme Court weakened the Voting Rights Act, states are scrambling to redraw congressional districts. Tennessee plans to dismantle its only Democratic seat in Memphis. Experts warn this could lock in one-party rule.

articles.title: From Reflecting Pools to Triumphal Arches: Trump's Sweeping Redesign of the Nation's Capital
articles.summary: President Trump is reshaping Washington, D.C.'s landscape with projects like a blue Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool and a planned triumphal arch. Critics say he's treating the city as a personal branding opportunity ahead of America's 250th anniversary.

articles.title: The 'Hidden Tax': How a Weakening Dollar Is Squeezing American Consumers
articles.summary: The U.S. dollar has fallen about 10% since Trump took office, the steepest six-month drop in over 50 years. While it helps big exporters, it acts as a "hidden tax" on imports, travel, and everyday goods.
